description: A test program for the tuxbox-framebuffer device that tests various display modes and pixel formats, including mode setting, color mapping, and drawing test patterns.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses arguments, sets framebuffer modes, and runs test patterns.

methods.name: setmode
methods.description: Configures the framebuffer to a specified pixel format and resolution.

methods.name: drawrect
methods.description: Draws a rectangle with specified color and pixel format onto the framebuffer.

methods.name: draw4field
methods.description: Creates a test pattern with four colored quadrants.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the program.

methods.name: col2pixel
methods.description: Converts a color to pixel data based on pixel format.
